profile.Name: Yamdu
profile.Personality: Polite, servile, and fearful; he stutters when told to stop calling people sir. He weighs every war by its profit for the Traders Guild and suggests assassinations and wars in a cheerful, businesslike tone.
profile.Backstory: Noble Squire Supreme to Longen. A Hive Prince who handles his master Longen's business at Trader's Edge, including sales of Traders Guild membership.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls everyone "sir" and signs off with "Safe travels, sir..." Talks about war in terms of profits and sales.
